mapper.select: select count(1) from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO info where info.hold_date = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, PRODID prodid, HOLD_DATE holdDate, CCY ccy, STATUS status, PRD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, AMOUNT amount, QTY qty, CNY_AMT cnyAmt, REMARK remark, ORG_CODE orgCode, DEPT_CODE deptCode, CREATE_DEPT createDept, DATA_SOURCE dataSource FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO info WHERE info.HOLD_DATE = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND info.STATUS = 'E' AND info.PRODID IN ( SELECT code.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_baseinfo code WHERE code.MDATE > #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND code.VDATE <= #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chb_investhold_info_sub SELECT CONCAT('F0', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'),right(REGIST_SEQNO,10)), REGIST_BANK_CODE, DATE_ADD(CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE,INTERVAL 1 DAY), PRD_REGIST_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, CCY, DATE_ADD(HOLD_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY), AMOUNT, QTY, CNY_AMT, REMARK, DATE_ADD(SUBMIT_DEADLINE,INTERVAL 1 DAY), WORKFLOW_ID, SEND_STATUS, NOW(), STATUS, CREATE_USER, NOW(), UPDATE_USER, NOW(), ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE , NULL, CONCAT('F0', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d'),right(REGIST_SEQNO,10)), CREATE_DEPT, CHECK_SEQNO, PRODID, NULL FROM chb_investhold_info_sub WHERE HOLD_DATE = #{holdDate}
